input: Start a language learning streak on Duolingo today

gold.taskTitle: Start a Duolingo language learning streak today
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to begin and maintain a daily Duolingo streak starting today.

questions.title: Which language are you learning on Duolingo?
questions.description: Identify the specific target language the user wants to study.

questions.title: Do you already have a Duolingo account set up?
questions.description: Determine whether the user needs to create an account or can start immediately.

questions.title: What is your current level in this language?
questions.description: Understand if the user is a complete beginner or has prior knowledge.

questions.title: How many minutes per day can you realistically commit?
questions.description: Establish the daily time budget the user has for Duolingo practice.

questions.title: What specific time of day will you do your lesson?
questions.description: Pin down a consistent daily slot to protect the streak.

questions.title: What is your main reason for learning this language?
questions.description: Understand the motivation behind the goal to help sustain commitment.

questions.title: Have you tried and broken a Duolingo streak before?
questions.description: Find out if past streak failures exist so obstacles can be addressed upfront.
